title: test_channel_plan.py: Channel assertion skipped entirely when expected value is missing
description: Lines 232-238: If none of `select_channel`, `expected_channel`, or `channel` keys exist in the vector, `actual_ch` is None and the assertion is bypassed via `if actual_ch is not None`. Test vectors missing expected channel values pass without any validation. Fix: either require the key or explicitly fail when no expected value is present.
close_reason: Fix already applied in commit 4c5c4af6cc. The code now explicitly requires expected_channel to exist in vectors (lines 288, 339) and fails if missing. All 33 tests pass.
